why: The sentinel's blow lands on the plinth's one cell, under a hammer that comes down flat on the floor round it. This edit widens the blow and the arming region to the 3 x 3 round the plinth, which `strike`'s slab covers, and makes the step strike with `hover`, a clip whose last frame brings the same slab down only to a block over the floor. Nothing of the statue comes down within a block of the floor on the eight cells round the plinth, yet a body standing on any of them would be hurt. It declares no unit: every field involved is bound by the primary, and what the engine refuses is a blow on a cell the limb never comes down on (shape 2 of the strike rule, forward) — a limb hanging over a body has not landed on it. The refusal names the cells and where the last frame does come down.
